Commitment Verifier v1.0.0 — initial release

- Analyzes agreements to distinguish genuine commitments from polite or deceptive yeses.
- Flags verbal deception signals and mismatches between words, tone, and body language.
- Classifies each agreement as Counterfeit, Confirmation, or Commitment yes.
- Generates Rule of Three follow-up questions to verify authentic commitment.
- Identifies missing stakeholders that may undermine commitment reliability.
- Designed for sales, negotiations, agreements, and any high-stakes decision process.
